label.zh: 工程大肠杆菌营养合成

after.description: 工程大肠杆菌携带还原甘氨酸途径，将甲酸来源的一碳单元导入中心代谢。设计包含 ftfL、fchA、mtdA、GCS（GcvTHP）与 H-protein 工程；通过 pflB 敲除减少碳流损失、gcvR 敲除解除 GCS 抑制，并以 sdaA 支持丝氨酸至丙酮酸转化。碳流分配用于单细胞蛋白与氨基酸积累，以及含 SmPePD 的功能营养支路。
after.description_en: Engineered E. coli carries the reductive glycine pathway to channel formate-derived one-carbon units into central metabolism. The design includes ftfL, fchA, mtdA, GCS (GcvTHP) and H-protein engineering. A pflB knockout reduces carbon loss, a gcvR knockout relieves GCS repression, and sdaA supports serine-to-pyruvate conversion. Carbon allocation supports single-cell protein and amino acid accumulation, alongside a functional-nutrition branch involving SmPePD.

after.name: BUCT

role.zh: Air2Protein · 电—生物催化营养合成

after.description: Air2Protein 是 BUCT 提出的模块化电—生物催化平台，面向火星大气资源利用与营养生产。平台通过电催化将 CO₂ 转化为甲酸／甲酸盐，以氨作为受控氮源，并评估 N₂ 制氨作为长期氮源供给模块。工程大肠杆菌通过还原甘氨酸途径将甲酸来源的一碳单元导入中心代谢，支持单细胞蛋白和氨基酸积累；β-丙氨酸支路用于 L-肌肽生产。系统面向火星原位食物制造，也考虑地球极端、资源受限环境中的应用。
after.description_en: Air2Protein is BUCT's modular electro-biocatalytic platform for Martian atmospheric resource utilization and nutrition production. Electrocatalysis converts CO₂ into formate/formic acid, with ammonia supplied as a controlled nitrogen input and N₂-to-NH₃ conversion evaluated as a long-term nitrogen-supply module. Engineered E. coli uses the reductive glycine pathway to channel formate-derived one-carbon units into central metabolism, supporting single-cell protein and amino acid accumulation; a β-alanine branch supports L-carnosine production. The system targets in-situ food production on Mars and applications in extreme, resource-limited environments on Earth.

narrative.en: Air2Protein is BUCT's modular electro-biocatalytic platform for Martian atmospheric resource utilization and nutrition production. Electrocatalysis converts CO₂ into formate/formic acid, with ammonia supplied as a controlled nitrogen input and N₂-to-NH₃ conversion evaluated as a long-term nitrogen-supply module. Engineered E. coli uses the reductive glycine pathway to channel formate-derived one-carbon units into central metabolism, supporting single-cell protein and amino acid accumulation; a β-alanine branch supports L-carnosine production. The system targets in-situ food production on Mars and applications in extreme, resource-limited environments on Earth.

after.description: 工程毕赤酵母利用甲醇，经中心代谢、MVA 通路与异源 EIZS 合成 EPI；设计通过关键酶、NADPH 和 ATP 调节改善前体及能量供给。蓝光 CRISPRi 提供三种候选策略，抑制竞争代谢或控制 EPI 末步，以协调生长和生产；光衰减模型指导高密度培养中的光照与诱导。防护设计包含细胞内黑色素、营养缺陷、低温响应自杀开关及反应器防尘、紫外过滤、透光和保温。EPI 进入两相发酵的上层有机相，经分离纯化获得产品，萃取相回用。
after.description_en: Engineered Pichia pastoris converts methanol through central metabolism, the MVA pathway and heterologous EIZS to EPI. Key-enzyme, NADPH and ATP regulation are designed to improve precursor and energy supply. Three candidate blue-light CRISPRi strategies suppress competing metabolism or control the final EPI step to coordinate growth and production; a light attenuation model guides lighting and induction in dense cultures. Protection includes intracellular melanin, auxotrophy, low-temperature-responsive suicide switches, and reactor dust barriers, UV filtering, light transmission and insulation. EPI partitions into the upper organic phase during two-phase fermentation, followed by separation and purification; the extraction phase is recycled.

role.zh: UniCO-Fuel · CO₂ 制 EPI 燃料

after.description: UniCO-Fuel 提出将火星大气 CO₂ 经光催化转化为甲醇，再由工程毕赤酵母通过 MVA 通路与 EIZS 合成 epi-Isozizaene（EPI），经两相萃取与纯化获得候选高能液体燃料。方案结合辅因子调节、蓝光 CRISPRi 动态代谢调控、光衰减模型及多层生物安全防护。
after.description_en: UniCO-Fuel proposes photocatalytic conversion of Martian atmospheric CO₂ to methanol, followed by engineered Pichia pastoris using the MVA pathway and EIZS to produce epi-Isozizaene (EPI). Two-phase extraction and purification yield a candidate high-energy liquid fuel. The design includes cofactor regulation, blue-light CRISPRi metabolic control, a light attenuation model and layered biosafety measures.
